load_qwen_model: load a pretrained Qwen model from the asset store by name or asset card
create_qwen_model: create a new Qwen model instance with a custom QwenConfig and optional device or dtype
list_qwen_archs: list all supported Qwen model architectures using get_qwen_model_hub().get_archs()
load_qwen_tokenizer: load a Qwen tokenizer from the asset store by name or asset card
iterate_qwen_model_cards: iterate over all available Qwen model asset cards using get_qwen_model_hub().iter_cards()
